units.name: guard-file@hosts.path
units.why_it_matters: restores /etc/hosts from canonical on any write

units.name: guard-file@nsswitch.path
units.why_it_matters: nsswitch.conf was the documented bypass: point hosts lookups away from files and the blocklist stops applying

units.name: guard-file@shutdown-schedule.path
units.why_it_matters: blocks loosening the curfew by editing /etc/shutdown-schedule.conf directly

units.name: guard-bind-mount@hosts.service
units.why_it_matters: read-only self-bind-mount blocks chattr at the VFS layer
